s.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Toast 12 slices white bread. Layer 300g roast turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo across three slices each. Pin with toothpicks and cut into quarters.

s.note: Carl's endless war on the gopher
s.how: Hollow a cob loaf and tear the inside into pieces. Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze and mix with 250g cream cheese, 150g sour cream, 50g parmesan and a crushed garlic clove. Fill the cob and bake at 180C for 25 minutes with the bread pieces around it.

m.note: the members' dinner at the club
m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C and rest 20 minutes. Bake 4 potatoes. Mix 2 tbsp horseradish into 200g sour cream. Carve thick and serve with the potatoes and chives.

w.note: the snack bar by the pool
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream, chopped peanuts and a cherry. Keep it well away from the pool.

d.n: Nineteenth hole peach iced tea lemonade
d.how: Brew 4 black tea bags in 500ml boiling water with 2 sliced peaches for 5 minutes, then remove the bags and cool with the peaches in. Make lemonade by stirring the juice of 3 lemons with 80g caster sugar and 400ml cold water. Fill four tall glasses with ice, pour in half tea and half lemonade, and add a peach slice, mint sprig and lemon wheel.
